# transforms.concepts: IRotational3D

**Status:** Supported (tier `foundation`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> A 3D rotation representation: converts to a unit quaternion, the canonical
> form every 3D rotation shares. A rotation is the rigid transform whose
> translation is zero, hence the inheritance.
> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quaternions\_and\_spatial\_rotation

## Signature

```plato
interface IRotational3D
    inherits IRigid3D
```
